# Actual Head generation of selected recursive records

Proof checkpoint: 31de18f2c. Verified start: 729c894df. Main: 9769fe3e9.
The ff-only refresh imports no change.

SourceCurrentHeadMuGeneration.head takes an actual completed Head, its
entry SemanticReady and CostHeap, its available input and an arbitrary
complete Mu selected in its return heap. It derives the same complete
cell at entry or a stored unfold that installs that cell during this Head.
The selected lookup key stays separate from the selected entry's key.
Every selected payload field stays equal throughout.

One tuple retains the full parent Mu, its availability and semantic/cost
support at the operation entry, literal unfold equation, selected-key
absence at entry and exact presence at return. It also retains an actual
issued Path from Head entry to operation entry, physical Grows and issued
Extends from operation return to Head return. It does not claim a public
unique operation occurrence or an actual suffix Path.

That SAME tuple retains the generated source Context, completed build and
rooted Written event. The syntax is encode (leaves parentBody) [] parentBody.
Its initial inputs are the actual stored leaves with the complete parent
Mu substituted for its own interned reference. The build derives the
selected first-write event. No operation, writer, desired ancestry or
empty initial History is a premise. The event can occur inside a probe
or a nested encoded binder. The operation need not return the target cell
as its value. Its initial inputs need not be empty.

The private proof follows actual collect execution by fuel and ordered
worklist. It respects visited union and Mu identities. At each actual
unfold, it checks whether the same target was already present at that
operation entry. Actual immutable nodeRecords retention gives either that
same complete entry cell or literal None. The latter case derives the
writer from the same completed encoded call. A later generating operation
receives the actual earlier issued Path. An earlier generating operation
receives the actual remaining suffix effects.

nodeEdges first unfolds a root Mu. If its result is not an ordinary node,
it runs collect on the ORIGINAL Mu at the later heap. These remain two
distinct chronological operations. Canonicalization preserves the heap.
Final Head makeNode cannot add a Mu. Its NoNewMu property moves the
selected full cell back to the actual exposure return; actual constructor
effects then extend the chosen operation's suffix to the Head return.
No reverse growth inference is used.

The actual fixture builds raw mu x.node7[raw mu y.node8[x,y]]. The inner Mu
captures outer self. The actual outer unfold rebuilds the inner binder
under the complete outer Mu and installs a new full selected cell. Its
key is literally absent at Head entry and contains that full cell at
Head return. Its exact row0 child0 lookup is checked. ONE application of
the public head producer therefore excludes the initial-cell arm. The
fixture retains the returned parent/operation/generated-build/Written
tuple without identifying it with an independent computed existential.
A later actual warm Head at the resulting heap is also checked. It is
not a second generation-producer application.

Official strict and constructed strict logs are empty. Canonical build,
public full statement/proof/axiom readback and constructed full readback
pass. Root personally observed default Audit handle55232 terminal0:
3488 jobs and 74053 axiom dependencies. Its sole warning is the earlier
ClosedCompletion unused-input warning. The prototype retains one failed
local equality attempt and its corrected selected attempt. Every Lean job
uses pinned Lean4.34.1, actual4GiB memory.max/high, zero swap and a
five-minute cap. Reviews add no Lean job or proof pair.

The next substantive producer must recover arbitrary selected-cell
generation through native maybeMu execution. Returned-value writer or
row lineage is insufficient for nested and probe-only cells. A generic
actual Trace can locate an optionalBinder instruction, but caller-written
code can also contain that instruction. The native request endpoint must
retain its SAME captured compileMu owner and actual bodyValue at entry.
Its generated syntax is binder true (encode (leaves bodyValue) [oldPair]
bodyValue), with initial inputs leaves bodyValue.

A final blocked maybeMu can already have installed nested full cells.
Yielded Trace alone omits these terminal effects. A stopping-outcome
rooted writer producer is needed for full coverage. Its completed-build
case already exists; an additive endpoint must also recover actual rooted
writers from pending source outcomes. Do not use private generated names
or edit frozen source. A bare issued Path or publication History does not
restore the missing original Reached source label.

Original program ancestry remains a further obligation. A generated root
and its nonempty mapped inputs do not by themselves carry an original
binding certificate. Full-self replacement gives no strict source/value
decrease. Native memo History stays at its checked captured reader.
Global renewal, all-owner exclusion, outer completion, convergence and
concrete Haskell refinement remain open. Conditional root-language and
Sized laws are unchanged. Enumeration, templates, subsumption,
replaceRows and external adapters retain separate implementation gaps.

No Haskell or active package file changes. FINDINGS keeps external repairs
first. The Typing documentation candidate remains unvalidated after its
cached-toolchain blocker. Preserve every earlier proof, counterexample,
repair, draft, stash and worktree. The full-library goal stays active.
Publication to formalize is authorized.

# Next native maybeMu generation and stopping rooted writers

Actual Head now recovers the generating stored unfold for any selected
complete Mu, with its same generated build and rooted writer, or its exact
initial full cell. Do not repeat this proof. Preserve its actual collect
order, original-Mu fallback, entry absence and physical/issued intervals.

Next recover arbitrary full-cell generation through actual native maybeMu.
The local completed-call extraction can use construct_eq and the existing
build_writer_or_prior. Keep generated root, initial leaves, parent bodyValue
and SAME rooted selected event together. Its entry-cell alternative must
continue through earlier actual execution. Returned-value origins miss
nested/probe cells and owners that have not returned.

An actual Trace optionalBinder-site locator is useful but does not prove
a captured compileMu owner. The request endpoint must also follow actual
compiled request, edge and walk chronology, with captured memo readers,
child trace and exact middle bodyValue. Do not replace an earlier captured
writer with the current requester. Keep native Retained distinct from
physical growth and issued history.

Do not omit the final blocked optionalBinder step. maybeMu.pending can
leave nested publications in its advanced heap. Add a stopping-state
rooted source writer endpoint for build Outcome.state. Existing private
build_supported/writers cannot be accessed by generated private names.
Prefer an additive producer using public foundations. The done branch
can reuse the existing completed-build theorem. The pending branch must
retain actual completed subcalls and their rooted route if that is used
to avoid duplicating the whole support induction. Audit every callback,
ordered list and constructor interval.

Only then attach native generated roots to original program binding
ancestry. Full self replacement supplies no strict decrease. Global renewal,
active-owner exclusion, outer completion, convergence and Haskell refinement
remain open. Keep FINDINGS external repairs first. The full goal stays active.

# Current composition and remaining original-root bridge

Historical source writer resume and nonunion terminal source suffixes
remain proved. Actual Head additionally recovers an actual generating
unfold with its SAME encoded build and rooted selected event. It handles
arbitrary selected full cache cells and retains the exact initial-cell arm.

The native maybeMu operation family is still separate. Recover its actual
operation and captured owner for arbitrary selected cells, including cells
installed by a final blocked call. Then link generated encoded roots and
nonempty leaf/self inputs to original program ancestry. Exact input slots,
first ordinary-child cuts and rooted source children already exist; none
alone proves that final original-root link or strict full-self decrease.

General renewal, all-owner exclusion, outer completion, convergence and
Haskell refinement remain open. Native memo History stays at its checked
captured reader. Do not infer it from Grows. Preserve every earlier result.
